title: With two claims named to one shared source root, host test credit always routes to the first claim (w-24055) even after the focus is moved to the second (w-4fea) before the command and the checkpoint
outcome: When one session holds two claims whose named source roots are the same worktree, a recognised check is credited to the claim that holds the session focus when the command starts. Or the host refuses the shared naming up front with a clear notice. It never silently credits the other claim, and the host's notice names which claim received the record and why.
acceptance: With two claims named to one shared source root, host test credit always routes to the first claim (w-24055) even after the focus is moved to the second (w-4fea) before the command and the checkpoint is done
